subject: Use __attribute__((aligned)) instead of packed
change_summary: Replaces packed alignment with aligned attributes in ARM and x86 paths.

units.name: Replaces packed alignment with aligned attributes in ARM and x86 paths.
units.evidence: AArch64 and x86 matrices prove 22 fixed public cases bidirectionally. ARMv6/v7 matrices prove 21 each; 200-byte XXH3 targets lack a return in source IR, so the affected ARM case is unverified.

notes: The verdict covers only the indicated targets and configurations; inconclusive cases are not counted as equivalence.
